Theorem
[Toponogov comparison] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0423, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0424 1. appG:G.33\group Comparison geometry For a complete Riemannian manifold with sectional curvature at least $k$, every geodesic triangle (within the positive-curvature perimeter restriction) has a $k$-comparison triangle. Its corresponding angles are no larger, the hinge opposite side is no shorter, and points on corresponding sides satisfy $d(q,s)\geq d(\widetilde q,\widetilde s)$.
